description: Defines a Data Transfer Object (DTO) class 'NoteUpdateRequest' used for updating notes, including validation and schema annotations.

classes.name: NoteUpdateRequest
classes.description: A DTO class used for encapsulating data required to update an existing note, including title, content, and optional tags with validation annotations.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Returns the title of the note.

methods.name: setTitle
methods.description: Sets the title of the note and returns the current object for chaining.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Returns the content of the note.

methods.name: setContent
methods.description: Sets the content of the note and returns the current object for chaining.

methods.name: getTags
methods.description: Returns the tags associated with the note.

methods.name: setTags
methods.description: Sets the tags for the note and returns the current object for chaining.
